checks.label: Intégrité des ressources
checks.scope: Actual346-fighter inventory plus explicit isolated rectangle fixtures for receipt ownership, refusal, raw bytes, crop, original-anatomy source gates and explicit immutable correction/held-promotion archives. Successful revision chains and rejected preconditions are exercised on real fixture files; fixtures are not generated creature media or artistic proof.

checks.label: Galerie et vrais PNG
checks.scope: Actual DEV gallery, real generated PNGs and exact read snapshot of the compiler register. Page lifecycle/transport delays are declared fixtures; no body completeness, original-animation, physical-device or global1:1 certification.

checks.label: Personnages puis stage
checks.scope: Default actual player documents and original controllers, trusted keyboard/pointer, real renderer images, separate character/arena/combat phases and actual BFCache. Standard gamepad data and one away document are explicit fixtures. DEV direct mode is checked separately; it is not evidence for the new default flow. No physical gamepad, screen-reader or artistic fidelity certification.

checks.label: Lecture des portraits et poses
checks.scope: Actual PNG bytes decoded by @napi-rs/canvas; current composite registry, lazy resolver, qualification faults, explicit historical and legacy contracts. Body-specific proof requires actual generated R34 body output. Synthetic contracts and delayed decoders are labelled fixtures; no original-game pixel, idle-cycle or global1:1 certification.

checks.label: Intégration du roster
checks.scope: Default R34 player flow on three actual documents. Exact registry snapshot, genuine raw PNGs and actual ImageBitmap/canvas thumbnails; explicit source-corruption, pressure, delayed callback and synthetic lifecycle fixtures. No original idle-cycle, fullbody portrait, physical-device, or global1:1 certification.

checks.label: Garde courant R34
checks.scope: R34 boundary fault injections. The original39 R33 and40 R32 cases execute unchanged after the exact reviewed R34 mount/pipeline projection; no original current functional assertion is removed.

checks.label: Intégration continue R34
checks.scope: Actually executed local parsing of seven main CI definitions and 21 exact legacy teststep adaptations, Bash/Python/JavaScript compilation and execution-ref-aware source-path checks. All 65 legacy preloads restore published workflow bytes on inverse projection and leave 12 browser assertions unchanged. Definition coverage and preserved recipe contracts are verified locally; no remote CI, gameplay, new media, original-animation or global 1:1 result is inferred.
